articles.title: Psyche Spacecraft Slingshots Past Mars, Capturing Rare Views and Validating Instruments
articles.summary: NASA's Psyche mission used a Mars flyby for a gravity assist, testing its instruments on a known planet. The spacecraft detected neutrons from Mars, measured its magnetic bow shock, and imaged the planet and its moons. The data confirms the tools are ready for the metal asteroid Psyche in 2029.

articles.title: Nudibranchs' Dazzling Hues Come from Microscopic Crystal Stacks, Not Pigments
articles.summary: Researchers have found that nudibranchs produce their vivid colors through structural coloration — stacks of guanine crystals under the skin reflect specific wavelengths. This creates intense, pixelated hues, with some slugs reflecting up to 80% of light. The discovery explains how they achieve such bright colors with a single material.

articles.title: Weakening Atlantic Ocean Current Could Supercharge California's Atmospheric Rivers
articles.summary: A study in Nature Communications shows that a slowing AMOC could intensify atmospheric rivers on the U.S. West Coast by altering moisture transport and steering winds. California faces heightened flood risks, while Greenland may see reduced snowfall. Cutting emissions could mitigate these effects.
